Summary: Paul's example command to Timothy, drafted as a general charge: let no man despise your youth, but be an example of the believers in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
Commandment: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
Application: Authority for the young leader is earned by example, not claimed by office: six spheres are named, from speech to purity. Addressed to Timothy, it is drafted because young believers in every generation face the same despising.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to make a life the credential where age cannot yet be one.
